verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 47.19
verses.english: Linked Discourses 47.19

verses.pali: 2. Nālandavagga
verses.english: 2. At Nāḷandā

verses.pali: Sedakasutta
verses.english: At Sedaka

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sumbhesu viharati sedakaṁ nāma sumbhānaṁ nigamo.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying in the land of the Sumbhas, near the town of the Sumbhas named Sedaka.

verses.pali: Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
verses.english: There the Buddha addressed the mendicants:

verses.pali: “bhūtapubbaṁ, bhikkhave, caṇḍālavaṁsiko caṇḍālavaṁsaṁ ussāpetvā medakathālikaṁ antevāsiṁ āmantesi:
verses.english: “Once upon a time, mendicants, a pole acrobat of the corpse-workers set up the bamboo pole of his tribe and said to his apprentice Medakathālikā,

verses.pali: ‘ehi tvaṁ, samma medakathālike, caṇḍālavaṁsaṁ abhiruhitvā mama uparikhandhe tiṭṭhāhī’ti.
verses.english: ‘Come now, dear Medakathālikā, climb up the bamboo pole and stand above my shoulders.’

verses.pali: ‘Evaṁ, ācariyā’ti kho, bhikkhave, medakathālikā antevāsī caṇḍālavaṁsikassa paṭissutvā caṇḍālavaṁsaṁ abhiruhitvā ācariyassa uparikhandhe aṭṭhāsi.
verses.english: ‘Yes, tutor,’ she replied. She climbed up the bamboo pole and stood above her tutor’s shoulders.

verses.pali: Atha kho, bhikkhave, caṇḍālavaṁsiko medakathālikaṁ antevāsiṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then the pole acrobat of the corpse-workers said to Medakathālikā,

verses.pali: ‘tvaṁ, samma medakathālike, mamaṁ rakkha, ahaṁ taṁ rakkhissāmi.
verses.english: ‘You look after me, dear Medakathālikā, and I shall look after you.

verses.pali: Evaṁ mayaṁ aññamaññaṁ guttā aññamaññaṁ rakkhitā sippāni ceva dassessāma, lābhañca lacchāma, sotthinā ca caṇḍālavaṁsā orohissāmā’ti.
verses.english: That’s how, guarding and looking after each other, we’ll display our skill, collect our fee, and get down safely from the bamboo pole.’

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, bhikkhave, medakathālikā antevāsī caṇḍālavaṁsikaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When he said this, Medakathālikā said to her teacher,

verses.pali: ‘na kho panetaṁ, ācariya, evaṁ bhavissati.
verses.english: ‘That’s not how it will be, tutor!

verses.pali: Tvaṁ, ācariya, attānaṁ rakkha, ahaṁ attānaṁ rakkhissāmi.
verses.english: You look after yourself, and I shall look after myself.

verses.pali: Evaṁ mayaṁ attaguttā attarakkhitā sippāni ceva dassessāma, lābhañca lacchāma, sotthinā ca caṇḍālavaṁsā orohissāmā’”ti.
verses.english: That’s how, guarding and looking after ourselves, we’ll display our skill, collect our fee, and get down safely from the bamboo pole.’

verses.pali: “So tattha ñāyo”ti bhagavā etadavoca, “yathā medakathālikā antevāsī ācariyaṁ avoca.
verses.english: That’s the way,” said the Buddha. “It’s just as Medakathālikā said to her tutor.

verses.pali: Attānaṁ, bhikkhave, rakkhissāmīti satipaṭṭhānaṁ sevitabbaṁ;
verses.english: Thinking ‘I’ll look after myself,’ you should cultivate mindfulness meditation.

verses.pali: paraṁ rakkhissāmīti satipaṭṭhānaṁ sevitabbaṁ.
verses.english: Thinking ‘I’ll look after others,’ you should cultivate mindfulness meditation.

verses.pali: Attānaṁ, bhikkhave, rakkhanto paraṁ rakkhati, paraṁ rakkhanto attānaṁ rakkhati.
verses.english: Looking after yourself, you look after others; and looking after others, you look after yourself.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, attānaṁ rakkhanto paraṁ rakkhati?
verses.english: And how do you look after others by looking after yourself?

verses.pali: Āsevanāya, bhāvanāya, bahulīkammena—
verses.english: By development, cultivation, and practice of meditation.

verses.pali: evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, attānaṁ rakkhanto paraṁ rakkhati.
Kathañca, bhikkhave, paraṁ rakkhanto attānaṁ rakkhati?
verses.english: And how do you look after yourself by looking after others?

verses.pali: Khantiyā, avihiṁsāya, mettacittatāya, anudayatāya—
verses.english: By acceptance, harmlessness, love, and sympathy.

verses.pali: evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, paraṁ rakkhanto attānaṁ rakkhati.
Attānaṁ, bhikkhave, rakkhissāmīti satipaṭṭhānaṁ sevitabbaṁ;
verses.english: Thinking ‘I’ll look after myself,’ you should cultivate mindfulness meditation.

verses.pali: paraṁ rakkhissāmīti satipaṭṭhānaṁ sevitabbaṁ.
verses.english: Thinking ‘I’ll look after others,’ you should cultivate mindfulness meditation.

verses.pali: Attānaṁ, bhikkhave, rakkhanto paraṁ rakkhati, paraṁ rakkhanto attānaṁ rakkhatī”ti.
verses.english: Looking after yourself, you look after others; and looking after others, you look after yourself.”

verses.pali: Navamaṁ.
